review_candidates.description: Department: Managed Services Location: Liss Technologies - Manhattan Compensation: $65,000 - $85,000 / year Description The Client Services Dispatch Engineer serves as the onsite resource for clients who need prompt, courteous, and effective technical support. In this role, you will travel to client locations to respond to requests for assistance in person, and will also provide support by phone and through standard support channels, while troubleshooting hardware, software, and basic system issues. The ideal candidate combines strong customer service skills with sound technical judgment, maintains accurate documentation, and delivers reliable support that helps end users remain productive. This position also plays an important role in escalating complex issues appropriately, following standard operating procedures, and contributing to a positive client support experience. This is a local, field-based position requiring regular travel to client sites. Key Responsibilities · Serve as the onsite point of contact for end users and client IT staff seeking technical assistance. · Travel to assigned client sites according to the dispatch schedule to complete scheduled visits and open service tickets. · Respond to incidents and service requests onsite at client locations, as well as through phone, email, and ticketing systems. · Troubleshoot and resolve basic to intermediate hardware, software, connectivity, and account access issues in a timely manner. · Maintain end-to-end ownership of support requests, ensuring timely follow-up, clear communication, and appropriate resolution. · Document incidents, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and user interactions accurately within the designated support system. · Escalate unresolved or high-impact issues to the appropriate support teams in accordance with established procedures. · Provide users with clear, easy-to-understand guidance and updates throughout the support process. · Perform onsite setup, configuration, and basic maintenance of workstations, peripherals, and standard business applications. · Monitor support queues and address tickets based on SOP · Participate in and adhere to all standard operating procedures, service standards, and departmental policies. · Identify recurring issues and share feedback or improvement opportunities with the broader support team. · Support a professional, service-oriented environment by demonstrating patience, accountability, and responsiveness in all client interactions. Skills, Knowledge and Expertise · Strong customer service, interpersonal, and communication skills. · Ability to diagnose and resolve common technical issues efficiently and accurately. · Working knowledge of desktop operating systems, business applications, printers, mobile devices, and basic networking concepts. · Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users. · Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in documenting incidents and resolutions. · Ability to prioritize multiple requests and work effectively in a fast-paced support environment. · Commitment to following procedures, maintaining professionalism, and delivering a high-quality support experience. Additional Details Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate will bring 2–5 years of experience in a field service, desktop support, or technical support environment, with a demonstrated ability to troubleshoot common hardware, software, and user-access issues effectively. This individual should be comfortable working face-to-face with end users at client sites, managing multiple requests, and maintaining a service-oriented approach in a fast-paced setting. Basic industry certifications are a plus and may include credentials such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, Microsoft fundamentals, or similar entry-level technical certifications. Day-to-Day Expectations On a typical day, this role involves traveling to assigned client sites and assisting users onsite with a wide range of technical needs. You will communicate with end users to gather relevant details, troubleshoot problems methodically, document actions taken, and ensure each issue is followed through to completion or properly escalated. Success in this role requires balancing responsiveness with accuracy, maintaining a professional and helpful demeanor, and contributing to a dependable support experience that reflects the standards of the Client Services team.

Strong problem-solving mindset, attention to detail, and willingness to learn new technologies and industry trends.

review_candidates.description: Build the platform behind one of the fastest-growing businesses in crypto. 'Engine' is the remote gaming server behind one of the world's largest online casino platforms, enabling game developers from around the world to integrate, launch and scale their games. Join our engineering team to build the backend platform, infrastructure and services powering thousands of games, billions of bets, and the future of online gaming. In just 18 months, we've grown to over 2,000 games , doubled in size this year alone, and continue expanding into new markets around the world. Our engineering team remains lean, giving every engineer real ownership and the opportunity to make decisions that directly shape the platform. Why Stake Engine? We believe great engineers should spend their time solving hard problems - not repetitive ones. AI is becoming a core part of how we build software. We're investing in AI-assisted development, evolving our Rust codebase and engineering standards so engineers can move faster, automate repetitive work, and focus on architecture, performance and product innovation. We're looking for engineers who embrace modern tooling and see AI as a force multiplier, not a replacement for strong engineering fundamentals. What you'll do This is a backend first role with exposure across Platform, DevOps and Data Engineering. Build and scale backend services using Go and Rust. Own production systems from design through to deployment. Build and optimise scalable cloud infrastructure with Kubernetes and Terraform. Contribute to data platforms powered by ClickHouse. Help evolve our architecture as we continue to scale globally. High ownership and autonomy from day one. Work across backend, infrastructure and data engineering. Build technology operating at significant global scale. What we're looking for You'll thrive here if you: Proven experience designing and building scalable backend systems, distributed architectures, and microservices. Enjoy owning systems end-to-end. Are comfortable balancing feature delivery with operational excellence. Have exposure to cloud infrastructure or DevOps. Love solving complex technical problems at scale. To make sure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experiences, we never discriminate on the basis of race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. We’re a global team of dreamers, creators, and game-changers from every walk of life, united by a passion for entertainment that inspires the world. We believe that the best ideas come from different perspectives, so we actively welcome and champion talent from all backgrounds, cultures, identities, and experiences. Whether you're just starting out or bringing decades of experience, your unique voice matters here.
